details: Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced significant withdrawals of $635 million, erasing nearly 60% of the inflows from the previous three days. This occurred as Bitcoin's price approached the estimated $81,500 cost basis of the ETF holdings.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See $635M Outflows, BTC Tests Cost Basis

details: Coinbase is discontinuing support for the roughly $13 million Japanese yen-backed stablecoin GYEN. This follows a 2021 trading controversy and a $6.75 million settlement with its issuer, with the stablecoin nearing the end of its wind-down.
title: Coinbase to Delist Japanese Yen Stablecoin GYEN

details: Worldcoin (WLD) saw a 13% price drop after a previously dormant institution transferred 19.74 million WLD tokens to exchanges. This triggered heavy short positioning and derivatives pressure, even as the broader market remained relatively flat.
title: Worldcoin Plunges 13% After Large WLD Transfer to Exchanges

details: Aave's (AAVE) price decreased by 5.5% after an inactive institution moved 156,690 AAVE ($22.9 million) and deposited 62,000 AAVE ($9.1 million) to exchanges, signaling potential selling pressure.
title: Aave Falls 5.5% as Major Holder Transfers $22.9M AAVE

details: NEAR Protocol (NEAR) fell 7.19% as crypto markets experienced a pullback. A tech stack dispute and increased scrutiny in derivatives markets amplified the decline amidst a broader risk-off environment.
title: NEAR Protocol Down 7.19% on Risk-Off Sentiment & Tech Dispute

details: Polkadot (DOT) has shown strong performance, increasing by approximately 5.2–5.3% in the last 24 hours. The multi-chain protocol token is trading near $1.18, making it one of the better-performing large-cap assets today.
title: Polkadot (DOT) Rises Over 5% in Last 24 Hours

details: Solana's Alpenglow network upgrade has gone live, marking a significant development. However, analysts are closely watching the $100 support level for SOL, as the price slid about 3% the day after the launch instead of rallying.
title: Solana's Alpenglow Upgrade Goes Live, $100 Support Key

details: Ethereum experienced its highest whale outflows in four months, with 169,770 ETH being moved. This indicates significant selling pressure from large holders, contributing to a bearish sentiment for the asset.
title: Ethereum Whales See 4-Month High ETH Outflows

details: Franklin Templeton has tokenized a U.S. Treasury Fund valued at $192 million on the XRP Ledger. This move highlights increasing institutional adoption of blockchain technology for traditional financial assets and expands XRP Ledger's use cases.
title: Franklin Templeton Tokenizes $192M US Treasury Fund on XRP Ledger

details: According to Ripple's CTO, the success and growing utility of the XRP Ledger (XRPL) could positively impact the price of XRP. This suggests that fundamental developments on the ledger are expected to drive value for the token.
title: Ripple CTO: XRP Price May Gain from XRPL Success

details: Dogecoin has launched its own dedicated company, 'Dogecoin Labs,' with the aim of building out and expanding the meme coin's ecosystem. This initiative suggests a move beyond its meme origins towards more real-world utility.
title: Dogecoin Launches 'Dogecoin Labs' for Ecosystem Development

details: Cardano's native token, ADA, has fallen to a five-year low price of around $0.20, dropping another 6% in the last 24 hours. Founder Charles Hoskinson warned that more firms in the Cardano ecosystem are likely to shut down this year due to market pressures.
title: Cardano Hits 5-Year Low, Hoskinson Warns of Failures
